BiblicalUsage: Only three times in the whole Bible, and all three are about moving a tent. Lot pitches his toward Sodom, Abram moves his to Mamre and builds an altar there, and Isaiah says no Arab will ever pitch a tent in ruined Babylon again.
TheologicalSignificance: The word itself is only a tent verb, and its weight lies in the scenes — Abram's tent beside his altar, Lot's pitched toward Sodom — not in the word alone.
